First, note the given date is 1288-11-08 (assuming format DD-MM-YYYY).  
Add 263 days:  

1288 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian rules apply but 1288 is before 1582, but we treat as proleptic Gregorian).  
Days left in November after 8th: 30 - 8 = 22 days.  
Remaining in 1288 after November:  
Dec: 31 days → total from Nov 9 to Dec 31 = 22 + 31 = 53 days.  

263 - 53 = 210 days into 1289.  

1289 is not a leap year (1289 % 4 = 1).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31.  
Sum to end of each month:  
Jan: 31 → 31  
Feb: 31+28=59  
Mar: 59+31=90  
Apr: 90+30=120  
May: 120+31=151  
Jun: 151+30=181  
Jul: 181+31=212  

210 days into the year means up to end of June is 181 days, so into July: 210 - 181 = 29 days.  
So date is 1289-07-29.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1289-07-29
